newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux mulls purchase of S.African Defy.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux mulls purchase of S.African Defy.

text.p: Swedish appliance maker Electrolux said on Wednesday that it was considering the purchase of South African white goods maker Defy that is owned by investment group Malbak.
"The company is for sale as far as we know and we are looking at it," Electrolux deputy managing director Lennart Ribohn told Reuters.

Swedish business daily Dagens Industri said on Wednesday that Electrolux had placed a bid for Defy believed to be worth between 320 and 480 million crowns. The newspaper said Defy had 30 percent of the South African white goods market.
Peter Beningfield, head of Defy, told the newspaper that the deal was expected to be clarified shortly.
